# Compression tool source archives

The copyright, license and readme files are unchanged copies from the Windows distributions. This directory also carries the published source archive for each matching version.

| Tool | Windows distribution | Source archive | Source SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pngquant 2.17.0 | [pngquant Windows ZIP](https://pngquant.org/pngquant-windows.zip) | [pngquant-2.17.0.tar.gz](https://pngquant.org/pngquant-2.17.0-src.tar.gz) | `a27cf0e64db499ccb3ddae9b36036e881f78293e46ec27a9e7a86a3802fcda66` |
| Gifsicle 1.95 | [Gifsicle Windows x64 ZIP](https://eternallybored.org/misc/gifsicle/releases/gifsicle-1.95-win64.zip) | [Windows distributor source archive](https://eternallybored.org/misc/gifsicle/src/gifsicle-1.95.tar.gz) | `b2711647009fd2a13130f3be160532ed46538e762bfc0f020dea50618a7dc950` |

The Gifsicle source archive also matches the [upstream source release](https://www.lcdf.org/gifsicle/gifsicle-1.95.tar.gz) byte for byte. The Windows binaries match the Windows ZIPs. The available release materials do not establish the exact compiler settings or dependency resolution used to build those binaries. See the PicGlance compression handoff for the binary hashes and verification details.
